rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for an organized set of related parts that work together.

example.jyutping: nei1 tou3 hai6 tung2 wan6 zok3 dak1 gei2 seon6

rows.note: Use this when “system” means a method or organized way of achieving something.

example.english: We need to find an effective system for organizing the data.
example.traditional: 我哋要搵個有效嘅方法整理啲資料。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 wan2 go3 jau5 haau6 ge3 fong1 faat3 zing2 lei5 di1 zi1 liu6

rows.note: Use this for the particular approach or way of doing or organizing something, rather than a formal system.

example.english: I think your system is quite practical.
example.traditional: 我覺得你呢個做法幾實際。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gok3 dak1 nei5 ni1 go3 zou6 faat3 gei2 sat6 zai3
